configs.name: Vanilla (score ≥ 3, no filter)
configs.rule: Entry when signal score ≥ 3. No macro filter.

configs.name: SPX > SMA(50)
configs.rule: Only trade when SPX is above its 50-day moving average.

configs.name: SPX > SMA(50) OR IEF > SMA(20)
configs.rule: Trade when EITHER stocks are trending up OR intermediate bonds are healthy.

configs.name: SPX > SMA(50) OR TLT > SMA(20)
configs.rule: Trade when EITHER stocks are trending up OR long-term bonds are healthy.

configs.name: Avoid yields rising fast
configs.rule: Skip trades when 10Y total return dropped > 0.5% in 5 days (yields spiking).
